name: Injective
notes: Default: the kit's icon_Injective-Ocean.svg (#4D3DFF), path unchanged and placed on the 64 grid; its clip path (the 48-unit viewBox square, which cuts nothing) is dropped. It replaces a copy of the same mark squashed about 2% horizontally (aspect 1.00 against the file's 1.02)
Mono: the same path in currentColor, as in the kit's one-colour icon_Injective-Black.svg and icon_Injective-White.svg (same geometry)
The kit's round token mark (Injective Token.svg) is the Inj coin unit, see icons/coin/inj.json
